name: Stitch with Google
summary: AI interface design tool that turns prompts, sketches and mood adjectives into UI, Figma files and HTML/CSS.
description: Google's AI-powered interface design tool for generating high-fidelity UI for web and mobile apps. Users describe a vibe in adjectives, mood-based palettes or hand-drawn sketches and get editable Figma files and frontend code (HTML/CSS); layouts are refined by conversation rather than manual editing. Its llms.txt defines a 3-layer prompt framework (anatomy, vibe, content) and an agent protocol that routes design requests into the tool.
contains: generates UI designs for mobile and web apps from text prompts, sketches or adjectives
outputs editable Figma files and frontend code (HTML/CSS)
adjective-driven styling, mood-based palettes and typography hierarchies
agent protocol for directing design requests to Stitch
